title: Version 0.0.8
html:
Version 0.0.8

December 18th, 2022

Added:

  • Added achievement UI
  • Added changelog UI (hi -aeunor)
  • Added economy UI
  • Added contribution UI
  • Added the boot
  • Vehicles can now be locked

Changes:

  • Schematics are no-longer selected when the menu first opens
  • DialogText & InspectText scale properly now
  • Menu background no-longer stretches
  • Changed menu background
  • PlayerList in the Permissions menu no-longer stretches

Fixed:

  • Patched the FIRST duplication glitch! Thanks Unsightly :)
  • Patched issue where hovering over items would spam the hover sound
  • Patched issue where loading times were increased
  • Patched spamming glitch in the topbar
  • Fixed issue where BuildMode wouldn't display the correct object
